change.before: "policies granting update or delete to an application applied to its sub-resources"
change.after: "update or delete actions only apply to the application itself; sub-resources require separate update/* or delete/* policies"

consequence.statement: RBAC policies granting update or delete permissions on Applications no longer automatically grant those permissions on managed sub-resources; operators must define separate policies with update/* or delete/* verbs to maintain access to application-managed resources.
consequence.remediation: Define new RBAC policies with update/* and delete/* verbs for managed resources, or set server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance to false in argocd-cm to preserve v2 behavior.

assertion.statement: Fine-grained RBAC policies granting update or delete to an Application no longer apply to its sub-resources by default; new policies granting update/* or delete/* are required for managed resources, with v2 behavior restorable via server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance=false in argocd-cm.
